senses.gloss: f. (בקק to enter into, search, v. P. Sm. 573; cmp. בִּינָא III, בִּינִיתָא a. פִּשְׁפָּשׁ) gnat.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 58b:2">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>לית ב׳ בר יומא</he> no gnat lives an entire day.
<cite ref="Chullin 58b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>תלו ליה לב׳ וכ׳</he> they suspended on the gnat’s proboscis sixty &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 58b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אמראי בקת׳ לבקא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אמרא ב׳ מבקא</he>) the she-gnat quarrelled with the he-gnat, v. <cite ref="M02651"><he>מרי</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>בַּקֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 26a:8">Succ. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>משום ב׳</he> on account of the gnats.
